note: How the gallery demonstrates each component. tool/gen_gallery.dart reads this together with ../../contracts/components.manifest.json and fails when the two disagree: every name the manifest claims must appear exactly once, in a demo's `shows`, in `undemoable`, or in `gaps`. The last two are different facts and the coverage page must not blur them -- `undemoable` is permanent and correct (the name has no visual form at all), `gaps` is work not done yet. A component the gallery has not reached needs no entry here (absence is not drift), but a claimed prop is never left silent.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form; every demo here has a visible label, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
undemoable.props.isInvalid: The invalid styling with no message is what `error` already renders, minus the line — there is nothing a demo could show that the error demo does not.

gaps.props.rounded: The rounding steps belong on one demo across every field, which KunInput's does not have either.
gaps.props.loadingText: The remote demo leaves it at the locale default; a demo that only swaps the string shows the string, not the component.
gaps.props.noResultText: The same: the basic demo shows the locale default when nothing matches.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form. The sizes demo sets one on every icon-only button because the contract requires it there, but what is announced is asserted by the widget tests, not seen in a gallery.
undemoable.events.click: Every button in every demo carries a live onPressed -- that is the floor this gallery was built to meet. A callback has no appearance of its own to show.

gaps.props.iconPosition: The sizes demo places its icon in the default left position only.

undemoable.events.click: Every card in the Interactive demo carries a live onTap, and the prop's one subtlety -- that it fires whether or not the card is clickable -- is a behaviour, not an appearance. A callback has nothing of its own to show.

undemoable.props.disabled: Swallowing taps has no visual form of its own; the widget tests assert the four kinds of tap.
undemoable.props.resolveMessage: The sentence a pinned-message service line quotes is asserted by the widget tests; the docs Service demo does not pin.
undemoable.props.showSender: The docs demos are a direct chat and never show the name; the widget tests cover showSender and deleted users.
undemoable.events.mention: A mention tap is the same callback as KunChatText; the widget tests cover preventDefault.
undemoable.events.user-click: Sender-name navigation is asserted by the widget tests; the docs demos never show the name.

undemoable.props.enterToSend: Enter-to-send versus newline is a keyboard behaviour asserted by the widget tests; auto follows Android/iOS versus other platforms.

undemoable.events.back: A callback has no appearance of its own; the widget tests fire onBack at both viewports.
undemoable.events.title-click: A callback has no appearance of its own; the widget tests fire onTitleTap.

gaps.slots.subtitle: The docs Basic demo uses the string prop; the widget tests cover the slot.

undemoable.events.sidebar-resize-end: A callback has no appearance of its own; the widget tests fire onSidebarResizeEnd at the end of a drag.
undemoable.events.update:sidebarSize: A callback has no appearance of its own; the widget tests fire onSidebarSizeChanged on each move.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form; every demo uses the locale default, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
undemoable.props.swipeToReply: A touch swipe is asserted by the widget tests; a desktop gallery cannot show the drag.

gaps.slots.actions: The docs Basic demo has no #actions; the widget tests cover the slot.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form; the basic demo uses the locale default, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
An accessible name has no visual form. The states demo names a group with it where there is no visible label, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
An accessible name has no visual form; the dialog name is asserted by the widget tests.
An accessible name has no visual form; every demo here has a visible alt, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.

gaps.props.autofocus: A demo page is the payload of an iframe, and a field that takes focus on mount steals the caret from the page hosting it. Showing this honestly needs a mount-on-demand control the gallery does not have.

undemoable.props.href: A href is a navigation token handed to KunUIConfig.navigate; it has no visual of its own. The widget tests fire navigate with it.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form. Every demo leaves it at the web's own fallback and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
An accessible name has no visual form; what a progressbar announces is asserted by the widget tests.

undemoable.props.disableAnimation: A still screenshot cannot show a skipped pop, burst or count-roll; widget tests assert that disableAnimation and reduced motion skip them.

undemoable.props.ariaLabel: An accessible name has no visual form. The basic demo names the strip with it, and what is announced is asserted by the widget tests.
